data.name: Fidha
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'F-D-H', meaning 'to free' or 'to liberate'. In Islamic context, it refers to the spiritual liberation attained through faith and submission to Allah. Fidha is also the name of a famous female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes freedom from worldly desires and attachment, and the pursuit of spiritual growth and closeness to Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the life path number 3 are creative and artistic. They love expressing themselves through various mediums and have a great sense of self-expression. They are also known for their charm and charisma.

in_arabic.name: فِضَا
in_arabic.meaning: فِضَا تعني الفضاء أو المكان الفسيح
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فِضَا مشتق من الفضاء، و يعني المكان الفسيح أو المفتوح. و في القرآن الكريم، الفضاء يرمز إلى السعة و الراحة. و يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على العطاء و السخاء.

in_urdu.name: فضا
in_urdu.meaning: فضا کا مطلب ہے وسیع جگہ یا کھلا ہوا علاقہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فضا عربی زبان کی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وسیع جگہ یا کھلا ہوا علاقہ. یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں عطا و سخاء کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے. قرآن کریم میں فضا کا ذکر سعة و راحتی کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے.

in_hindi.name: फिज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फिज़ा का अर्थ है खुला स्थान या विस्तृत जगह
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फिज़ा अरबी जड़ों से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है खुला स्थान या विस्तृत जगह. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उदारता और दान की प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है. कुरआन में فضا का उल्लेख विस्तार और सुविधा के रूप में किया गया है.

in_pashto.name: فضا
in_pashto.meaning: فضا د خلاصې يا پراخنۍ ځای معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فضا نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د خلاصې يا پراخنۍ ځای معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د سخاوت او عطا د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي. قرآن کريم کې فضا د سعادت او راحتۍ په معنا استعمال شوی دی.

in_english.name: Fidha
in_english.meaning: Fidha means open space or vast area
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fidha originates from Arabic roots, meaning open space or vast area. In Islamic tradition, Fidha symbolizes generosity and charity. The Quran references Fidha as a symbol of spaciousness and comfort. This name is used across Muslim cultures to signify a sense of freedom and expansiveness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fidha holds an important place in Islamic culture, especially in Sufi (Islamic mysticism) tradition. It is believed that the name possesses protective and liberating qualities. In various parts of the Islamic world, especially in South Asia, Fidha is used as a name for girls, symbolizing release from bondage and offering spiritual empowerment. The remembrance of this name is often invoked during spiritual practices to seek deliverance from afflictions and worldly troubles.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fidha holds profound spiritual significance as it reflects the ultimate goal of the Islamic faith - attaining freedom from the shackles of earthly desires and transient materials to find inner peace and divinely ordained salvation. It is a reminder of the ultimate reality that we are servants of Allah and our true freedom lies in our submission to His will. By invoking the name Fidha, one seeks refuge in Allah from the trials and tribulations of this world. The name serves as an inspiration, reminding us of the power of faith and submission to overcome obstacles, purify the soul and attain spiritual liberation.
